contradiction_resolution: The narrow recovery lemma is correct conditionally: O_C(Gamma)=L gives M=omega_C(-Gamma), the weak CE normalization supplies M=gamma^*O_P1(1), and Riemann-Roch gives h^0(M)=h^0(L)-1=2. The two pulled-back coordinate sections therefore form all of H^0(M), so gamma is the complete pencil |M| and is determined only up to PGL_2. This repairs the group distinction in FND-0137 in the pencil-preserving sense and implements the recovery route already identified in FND-0098. It does not identify Aut(C,Gamma) with strict deck transformations over a fixed target. The claim that rigidity applies verbatim requires the additional marked-image and etaleness open conditions and is not valid on the entire incidence as written. Its B_4 clause is not a second stratum of the cited balanced weak-normalization locus: corroborated FND-0134 makes h^0(L)=3 throughout that locus, so B_4 is empty there and must be treated as an out-of-scope warning. FND-0138 is also absent from proof/findings.jsonl and exists only as the pending candidate embedded in TASK.json. Accordingly its verified content should be merged as a scoped addendum to FND-0137, cross-referencing FND-0098, rather than promoted as an independent finding.

scope.automorphism_convention: Pencil-preserving, not strict over a fixed target P1.
scope.excluded_scope: No unique pencil is recovered when h^0(omega_C(-Gamma)) exceeds 2. The asserted B_4 behavior is outside the balanced weak-normalization locus, where the packet already establishes h^0(L)=3 on every geometric fibre.
scope.locus: Balanced genus-six degree-four covers satisfying the weak Casnati-Ekedahl relative-canonical normalization, with an incidence divisor Gamma such that O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L and h^0(L)=3, equivalently h^0(omega_C tensor L^{-1})=2.
scope.rigidity_restriction: The marked-image rigidity argument applies only on the further open locus having three distinct marked images and at least one gamma-etale marked point.
scope.verified_conclusion: The complete base-point-free linear system |omega_C(-Gamma)| recovers the tetragonal pencil up to PGL_2. Consequently Aut(C,Gamma) equals the automorphism group preserving Gamma and the tetragonal pencil, where an automorphism may induce a target transformation tau in PGL_2.
